stimulus.body: Solve the problem stated in the question using the relevant discrete-mathematics principle.

questions.stem: How many Boolean functions exist on 4 variables? Compute the value, carefully.
questions.explanation: There are 2^4=16 input rows and each can map to 0 or 1, so there are 2^16=65536 functions. Counting only rows confuses the domain size with the number of functions.
questions.hint: Two to the number of truth-table rows.
